subject: Stake
body:
Bot's up since launch. Letting a few wallets in.

Send any amount to my coinbin, 0x5e17a0c94b2d83f6e1a7c05b9d42e38f6a1c0d7b. Everything sent there gets staked. Send more whenever, it adds up.

The deal: each send pays out exactly 4 days later, 12:00. At whatever it's worth then. Up or down, same as the book. No early exits.

Your stake shows on the vibe check.

outcomes.when: the player says they're in or will send money, but hasn't sent anything yet

hints: Any amount to the wallet. Each send pays out 4 days later, 12:00. Up or down.
